red_flag_symptoms.message: Chest pain/tightness mentioned — rule out ACS, PE, aortic dissection.
Syncope reported — consider cardiac arrhythmia, vasovagal, or neurological cause.
Dyspnea on exertion — consider cardiac or pulmonary cause given BNP elevation.
Breathlessness — consider cardiac or pulmonary cause given BNP elevation.
Sudden weakness — rule out stroke (FAST assessment).
Acute vision loss — ophthalmology urgent review.
Thunderclap headache — rule out subarachnoid haemorrhage.
Palpitations with known hypertension — consider ECG.
Unexplained weight loss — screen for malignancy, uncontrolled diabetes (HbA1c 8.1%).

symptom_combinations.message: Chest pain + arm symptoms — high suspicion for ACS. Consider immediate ECG.
Leg pain + dyspnea — consider DVT/PE. Wells score warranted.
Fatigue + dyspnea + chest symptoms — cardiac decompensation possible given BNP 210.

drug_interactions.message: Aspirin + Ibuprofen: Ibuprofen may competitively inhibit Aspirin's antiplatelet effect and increases GI bleed risk.
Metformin with eGFR 58 mL/min — approaching threshold for dose reduction (hold if eGFR <45). Monitor renal function.
NSAID use with reduced eGFR (58 mL/min) — NSAIDs can acutely worsen renal function. Consider alternatives.
Levothyroxine + Calcium: calcium supplements reduce levothyroxine absorption — separate by 4 hours.
